3x3 Eyes - Kyuusei Koushu S.name: 3x3 Eyes: Kyuusei Koushu S
3x3 Eyes - Kyuusei Koushu S.summary: 3x3 Eyes: Kyuusei Koushu S, is an adventure game based on the 3x3 Eyes manga.

Jikkyou Oshaberi Parodius - Forever with.name: Jikkyou Oshaberi Parodius: Forever With Me
Jikkyou Oshaberi Parodius - Forever with.summary:
Released a year after Jikkyou Oshaberi Parodius, this port for the Sega Saturn and PlayStation includes improved graphics and sound over the Super Famicom release.

Additional features include a cheat to replace "Tokimeki People's Dance" with an enhanced version, "Days Of The Dream's Memories", several "Omake" stages, and unlockable characters Dracula-kun and Kid Dracula. The two-player game also allows both players to play simultaneously instead of just alternately like in the Super Famicom game.

Lunacy.name: Lunacy
Lunacy.summary: Lunacy, released in Europe as Torico and in Japan as Gekka Mugentan Torico (月花霧幻譚 Torico), is an adventure game developed by System Sacom and published by Sega for the Sega Saturn in 1996. Lunacy is an interactive movie adventure consisting of a long series of interconnecting full motion video (FMV) sequences, much like The 7th Guest and System Sacom's earlier Saturn game, Mansion of Hidden Souls.

Matsukata Hiroki no World Fishing.name: Matsukata Hiroki no World Fishing
Matsukata Hiroki no World Fishing.summary: Matsukata Hiroki no World Fishing is a Sports game, published by BPS and Media Quest, which was released in Japan in 1996.01.19 and 1996.02.02 .

Private Idol Disc Vol. 11 - Mayumi Hiros.name: Private Idol Disc Vol. 11: Mayumi Hirose
Private Idol Disc Vol. 11 - Mayumi Hiros.summary: Idol Digital Photobook released exclusively in Japan for Sega Saturn. Includes a Q&A interview, a mini-game, and a quiz about Mayumi Hirose.

World Cup Golf - Professional Edition.name: World Cup Golf: Professional Edition
World Cup Golf - Professional Edition.summary:
Take on the best with WORLD CUP GOLF: Professional Edition. Get onto the green in the Practice mode, and work on any hole that gives you problems. In Normal mode, challenge the course alone or play against someone with 15 different game types such as skins and match play.

Tournament mode provides you with the ability to create your own event. No matter how you play the course, you'll have full control over your player's stance as well as the weather and the ground conditions. While you play, your auditory sense is treated to CD quality music and digitized speech. See how long you would last as an expert in WORLD CUP GOLF: Professional Edition.
